name: Dr Adam Brownhill
title: Dr / General Practitioner (MBBS, MRCGP (UK), FRACGP, FARGP)
description: Dr Brownhill is a general practitioner with over 25 years' clinical experience, with a focus on gender-affirming care and long-term patient relationships. TG Health Clinic provides individualised gender-affirming hormone care based on the informed-consent model, with ongoing monitoring and support; GAHT implant insertion is available, and patients already on GAHT can continue or review their treatment. He is a member of AUSPATH, ASIAPATH, and WPATH. In-clinic and telehealth appointments; no referral required.
specialties: gender-affirming hormone therapy (GAHT), GAHT implants, general practice

name: Equinox (Thorne Harbour Health)
title: Trans and gender diverse general practice
description: Equinox is our clinic specialising in trans and gender diverse health. Start, continue or manage gender-affirming hormone therapy with an Equinox GP using the Informed Consent Model; we provide ongoing hormone management, monitoring and support, plus general care, sexual health and referrals for gender-affirming surgery. A separate Specialist Hormone Initiation (endocrinology) service supports adults aged 18+ with a GP referral, in person or by telehealth anywhere in Victoria. GP and endocrinologist appointments are bulk billed for Medicare card holders.
specialties: gender-affirming hormone therapy, trans and gender diverse primary care, sexual health, PrEP, endocrinology
